title: Settings
generalDescription: Card width, page size and window behaviour.
appearanceDescription: Theme mode, contrast, corners and fonts.
liveSourcesDescription: Platform display, order and follows auto-refresh.
playbackSettingsDescription: Playback preferences and the player engine.
systemDescription: General, network, diagnostics, data and backups.
dataCacheDescription: Watch history, follows import/export and cover cache.
playbackDescription: Quality, aspect ratio and player behaviour.
vodDescription: Bilibili account, default quality and video-station behaviour.
backupDescription: Local backups, restores and WebDAV sync.
playbackComingSoon: Playback settings arrive with the player.
sitesComingSoon: Site management and accounts are on the way.
dataComingSoon: Data management is on the way.
cardExtentDescription: How wide one feed card gets; smaller means more per row.
refreshRateModeDesc: Power saving leaves the rate to the system (or pins 60 Hz where content matching exists); balanced raises the rate only during touch or scroll on Android and releases it 1.5 s afterwards; performance holds the highest rate while foregrounded. Options the platform cannot carry are hidden.
refreshRateReadOnlyDesc: The system gives the app no refresh-rate request path; the values above are the actual reading of this display.
autoCheckUpdateDesc: Reads the release feed once per start, silently; the result appears under About, and a failure stays quiet.
windowSizeDesc: The frame the window opens with; applying centers it and remembers the size.
windowSizeApplyFailed: The window size could not be applied.
startupDesc: Open Pure Live after you sign in; the switch reads the real system entry.
startupFailed: The login setting could not be changed
splashAnimationDesc: Shows the app mark before the shell; applies on the next start.
configPreviewDesc: The settings a backup carries, read-only as JSON; copy it if needed.
autoShutdownDesc: Quits the app when the countdown ends; turning it off cancels immediately.
autoShutdownInvalid: Enter a number between 1 and 525600 minutes.
refreshRateFailed: The refresh rate could not be read
refreshRateApplyFailed: The refresh-rate request did not take effect
refreshRateMultiMonitorDesc: The reading belongs to the display the current window is on.
pageSizeDescription: How many rooms one desktop page shows; sites are fetched in their own windows and sliced locally, so paging never skips rooms.
favoritesDenseDescription: Display more favorite rooms at once; off uses large cards.
sitesDisplayDesc: Switched-off platforms leave the popular and areas tab lists.
dataClearHistoryDesc: Deletes every watch record, for good.
dataExportFollowsDesc: Copies the follow list to the clipboard (JSON).
dataImportFollowsDesc: Reads previously exported follows from the clipboard (JSON).
dataBadData: The clipboard could not be read as follows
confirmClearDesc: Every watch record will be deleted, for good.
aboutLicenseDesc: The open-source packages this app builds on.
themeSeedDynamicDescription: Chosen by the system while dynamic colour is on; turn it off to pick an accent.
dynamicColorDescription: Build the theme from the system wallpaper or accent, overriding the accent colour.
loadingStyleDescription: The animation shown while pages, lists and players load.
loadingStyleChooseHint: The choice applies to every loading state at once.
loadingColorDescription: The loaders' colour; empty follows the theme's accent.
loadingColorHexInvalid: Enter a 6- or 8-digit hex colour, such as #2196F3.
themeColorHexInvalid: Enter a 6- or 8-digit hex colour, such as #2196F3.
followsAutoRefreshDesc: Refreshes the follow list on an interval while the page is open.
historyLimitDesc: The oldest records past the limit are dropped.
networkDescription: The app proxy and transport behaviour.
proxyDesc: When on, the vod, guide and backup requests all route through it.
toolsOrderDesc: The order of the tools under the sidebar's divider.
shieldDescription: Blocked keywords and users; the live room filters by them.
prefScopeDesc: Keep these changes in this window, or apply them to the main window and every room window.
roomWindow: Open rooms in their own windows
roomWindowDesc: A window per room, like a chat app; off, rooms open inside the main window. Desktop only.
closeActionDesc: What the close button does. Hide to tray keeps the app running; click the tray icon to bring the window back.
noExitConfirmDescription: Close the window with the action above without asking. Turn it off to confirm every time.
closeWindowQuestion: Quit the app, or keep it running minimized?
fontDescription: UI typeface: the platform's own face, or one of the bundled official ones.
textScaleDescription: Scales the app's text as a whole; 100% keeps the platform size.
textScalePreview: Preview: the change applies to every screen at once.
cacheDescription: The disk cache for covers and avatars, and its cleanup cap.
cacheClearDesc: Deletes every cached cover, avatar and site icon.
cacheLimitDesc: Oldest images are deleted past the cap; off keeps only expiry-based cleanup.
cacheHint: Covers and avatars are kept on this device for 30 days and pruned when they expire or pass the cap.
preferPlatformDesc: The platform the popular and areas pages open with.
sitesOrderResetDesc: Platforms return to the built-in order; the show switches stay as they are.
windowChromeDesc: Use the system caption, or the app's own strip; a restart applies the change.
windowChromeRestartTitle: Restart to apply the title bar?
windowChromeRestartDesc: The caption style is chosen when the window is created; it applies after a restart.
navigationDescription: The sidebar's entries and their order.
refreshDescription: Automatic refresh for the follow list and live covers.
proxyDescription: The app-wide proxy every site request goes through.
platformsDescription: Platform visibility, order and account sign-in.
crossSpacingDescription: The gap between two cards side by side in a grid.
mainSpacingDescription: The gap between two rows of cards in a grid.
vodQualityDesc: The quality the page asks for first; without a Bilibili sign-in the source may serve 720P or lower.
iptvSyncDesc: Re-downloads network playlists and guides; local sources stay untouched.
videoDescription: Quality, audio and how the picture fits.
kernelDescription: Engine, proxy, hardware decoding, presets and picture enhancement.
kernelOnlyOne: Only the mpv engine is available on this platform.
kernelSwitchHint: New players use the chosen engine.
playerPresetsHint: One tap switches decoding, output and buffering; affects the player only.
presetBalancedDesc: Engine defaults, balancing picture and performance.
presetCompatDesc: mediacodec surface and decoding for glitchy devices.
presetRtxVsrDesc: D3D11VA decoding with d3d11vpp for NVIDIA GPUs.
presetLowEndDesc: Software decoding, lower resolution and smaller buffers.
presetLowLatencyDesc: Small buffers and frame dropping for fast links.
playerProxyDesc: Only the player's requests; the app's own proxy is unchanged.
playerProxyInvalid: Enter a valid host and port (1–65535).
customOutputDesc: Pick the video and audio output drivers manually.
videoOutputHint: gpu / gpu-next / direct3d may open an mpv window; embedded video usually stays on libmpv or auto.
interpolationDesc: Motion interpolation; recommended on desktop GPUs only.
scaleKernelDesc: Resampler used when upscaling the picture.
forceDestroyDesc: Dispose the player immediately when leaving a room.
mpvResetDesc: Reset output, sync, scaling and decoding; super resolution is kept.
playerGuideIntro: The player runs on mpv. Start with a preset; tune advanced options only when the picture still misbehaves.
playerGuideTip1: Green or torn picture: try Android compatibility, or change the hardware decoder.
playerGuideTip2: Soft picture: leave the low-end preset, pick a quality scaler or super resolution.
playerGuideTip3: Stutter: use Unstable network; loud fans: turn interpolation and super resolution off.
playerGuideTip4: No sound: check the audio output driver; on Windows try turning exclusive audio off.
superResolutionEfficiencyDesc: The lighter CNN chain for mid-range GPUs.
superResolutionQualityDesc: The heaviest CNN chain, sharpest result.
playerAdvancedRequiresMpv: These options only affect the mpv engine.
superResolutionDescription: Upscales the picture live with Anime4K shaders; needs a desktop GPU.
superResolutionHint: Windows desktop only; applies to the current and later players.
recordingDescription: Recording folder, file naming and the size cap.
preferredQualityDesc: The resolution tier a room opens on; when the site has no exact label, the nearest tier is chosen. Original by default.
preferredQualityCellularDesc: The resolution tier used on cellular data; Wi-Fi and wired keep the preferred quality above.
defaultVolumeDesc: New players start at 50% on phones and tablets and 100% on desktop; the slider changes this platform.
globalMuteDesc: Silences every room, channel and video now and when opened; turning it off restores each player's own mute choice.
fitDesc: How the frame fills its box.
miniDanmakuVisibleDesc: Whether the flying layer still draws in the compact window.
miniDanmakuHint: The look is shared with the Danmaku page.
engineDesc: Supplied by media_core's kernel registry; only mpv is registered.
hardwareDecodingDesc: Decode with the GPU; off hands the work to the CPU.
hardwareDecodingHint: Applies to the next player instance.
refreshOnResumeDesc: Refresh the follow list once when the app comes back.
maxConcurrentRefreshDesc: How many rooms are queried at once. The reference recommends 4; range 1–20.
refreshThumbnailsDesc: Periodically clears the image cache so covers, avatars and logos are downloaded again; history and follows stay.
multiviewVisibleDesc: Hides the multi-view entry from the sidebar.
contrastDescription: How strongly control edges and text stand out.
selectionDescription: How selected rows and controls are highlighted.
autoClashDesc: Shifts nearby danger and success colors automatically, so a selection is not read as an alert.
backgroundDescription: An image or video behind the app, uploaded from a file or loaded from a URL.
backgroundImagesDescription: Official, Wallhaven, Bing and deepin sources; preview before applying.
randomWallpaperDescription: Fetch from public random APIs, grouped; preview before applying.
backgroundVideosDescription: iTab live wallpapers; preview before applying.
backgroundDeviceDescription: Upload an image or video, or enter a network address.
backgroundPreviewVideoHint: Video backgrounds play behind the app.
backgroundInvalidUrl: The address must be an http(s) link
backgroundEmpty: No media yet; choose Image or Video, then enter a URL or upload a file.
backgroundMaskDescription: Darkens or lightens the backdrop so text stays legible.
backgroundBlurDescription: Blurs the picture or video for busy wallpapers.
backgroundClearDescription: Returns to the theme's own surface; the saved media stays for later.
checkUpdateDesc: Reads the newest version from the project’s releases.
releaseHistoryDesc: The project’s releases and what changed in each.
sitesKeepOne: Keep at least one platform visible
autoPipDesc: Enter picture-in-picture when the app goes to the background while playing; needs the system permission.
keepScreenOn: Keep the screen awake while playing
keepScreenOnDesc: Prevents the display from sleeping while a room or channel plays; pausing returns to the system policy.
audienceMetricDesc: The figure cards lead with on popular and followed rooms.
backgroundLibraryLocalHint: The deepin set is built in and needs no network.
backgroundLibraryNetworkHint: The library reads the public iTab API; the app proxy applies.
